narrativeArcs.title: Luca before Rome
narrativeArcs.description: Short A1 stories about Luca's life in Pietralba before he goes to Rome. Breadth and comprehension — not five levels, and not A1 mastery by themselves.

narrativeArcs.title: Luca in Rome
narrativeArcs.description: Luca arrives in Rome and builds a new life. Existing chapters 1–40. Do not renumber.

narrativeArcs.title: Elena goes home
narrativeArcs.description: Independent A1 draft. Not part of Luca's journey. Not one of the five pre-Rome stories.

stories.title: Luca introduces himself
stories.description: In Pietralba, Luca introduces himself, his age, his family, and his home. The learner meets who Luca is before any journey begins.

stories.title: A day in Luca's life
stories.description: One ordinary day in Pietralba, driven by clock time, days, dates, and schedules. Luca's routine — not a Rome work plot.

stories.title: At the supermarket
stories.description: Luca shops with a list: food, quantities, prices in euros, and counter talk. Practical transactions, not a stroll through town.

stories.title: Around town
stories.description: Luca moves through Pietralba: places, directions, weather, seasons, bus, and the local station. His world grows beyond the house without leaving for Rome.

stories.title: Luca's party
stories.description: Luca's birthday: invitations, likes, family, and friends. The party ends with goodbye at Pietralba station — tomorrow he leaves for Rome. Do not arrive in Rome.

stories.title: Luca in Rome
stories.description: Luca arrives in Rome, finds a home and work, and builds a new life.

stories.title: Elena goes home
stories.description: Independent A1 draft. Story-local cast and Castelbianco locations. Incomplete prose and questions.
